input.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib
import re
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

SERIAL = "4ae24c72"
OUT = Path("/tmp/heals-monitor")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
VOLATILE = re.compile(
    r"^(\d{1,2}:\d{2}|\d{1,3}%|[\d.]+ ?(KB|MB)/s|5G|4G|LTE|Wi-Fi|VPN)$",
    re.I,
)


def dump_xml() -> str:
    subprocess.run(
        ["adb", "-s", SERIAL, "shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "/sdcard/uidump.xml"],
        check=False,
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["adb", "-s", SERIAL, "exec-out", "cat", "/sdcard/uidump.xml"],
        check=False,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    return result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")


def stable_text(xml: str) -> str:
    texts = re.findall(r'\b(?:text|content-desc)="([^"]*)"', xml)
    kept = []
    for text in texts:
        cleaned = text.replace("
", " ").strip()
        if not cleaned or VOLATILE.match(cleaned):
            continue
        kept.append(cleaned)
    return "\n".join(kept)


def main() -> None:
    previous = None
    while True:
        xml = dump_xml()
        text = stable_text(xml)
        if not text:
            print("UIDUMP_FAIL", flush=True)
            time.sleep(2)
            continue
        digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        if digest != previous:
            kind = "SCREEN_BASELINE" if previous is None else "SCREEN_CHANGED"
            (OUT / f"ui-{digest}.txt").write_text(text)
            (OUT / f"ui-{digest}.xml").write_text(xml)
            shot = OUT / f"screen-{digest}.png"
            with shot.open("wb") as handle:
                subprocess.run(
                    ["adb", "-s", SERIAL, "exec-out", "screencap", "-p"],
                    check=False,
                    stdout=handle,
                )
            print(f"{kind} {digest}", flush=True)
            print(text.replace("\n", " | "), flush=True)
            previous = digest
        time.sleep(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
